build_generalized_rcnn_from_config: build a GeneralizedRCNN model from a detectron2 config with backbone, proposal generator, and ROI heads
run_rcnn_forward_training: run the GeneralizedRCNN forward pass to compute detection losses on a batch of input images
run_rcnn_inference: run inference with GeneralizedRCNN to detect objects and return predicted boxes, classes, and scores
run_proposal_network_forward: run the ProposalNetwork forward pass to generate object proposals with bounding boxes and objectness logits
visualize_rcnn_training_proposals: visualize training proposals by overlaying ground truth boxes and predicted proposals on input images
